title: Annotation API v2 NER-NEL response
description: Response body of POST /api/v2/entities/ner-nel/: NER then NEL on the detected mentions. Same envelope as /api/ner-nel/; `nes` is always a list of batch NEL entities.

ts.description: UTC time at which the response was produced, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

sys_id.description: Identifier of the system (model) that served the request.

NEL seconds.description: NEL processing time in seconds. Frozen wire name containing a space.

NER seconds.description: Time of the NER step in seconds. Frozen wire name containing a space.

nes.description: Linked mentions found in the text. Always a list; `[]` when nothing is found.
